svg.title: Wargrid HUD — true-scale concept, 1920 × 1080
svg.desc: 25 own units and 15 enemies. Twelve selected units, pinned Vehicle Factory with nine queue slots. White world selection; teal UI focus. Low-power radar state. Optional UX panels are labeled. Vector concept, not a game capture.

g.text: Building actions stay in this panel
Click a queued unit to cancel
